device.name: OpenEVSE / EmonEVSE Charging Station
device.notes:
OpenEVSE (and the EmonEVSE variant) is an open-source EV charging station: an ESP32 Wi-Fi gateway wraps a controller board that speaks the RAPI serial protocol. Everything is local and open — HTTP API + WebSocket + MQTT, with optional OCPP 1.6-J. No cloud is required.
HTTP: the ESP32 serves a web UI and JSON API (/status, /config, /override). A WebSocket pushes live updates. Historically a RAPI passthrough existed at /r?rapi=<command> but it is deprecated in favour of the HTTP API.
MQTT: base topic openevse-xxxx. Status subtopics /amp, /wh, /temp1..3, /pilot, /status published ~every 30 s; control via /override/set, /claim/set, /schedule/set, /limit/set, /divertmode/set, /restart; a RAPI bridge is at <base>/rapi/in/$SC 13 -> <base>/rapi/out/#. Announce: a retained message on openevse/announce/xxxx carries state, hostname and IP.
RAPI (controller serial): commands are $cc pp..^xk\r where ^xk is an 8-bit XOR checksum (legacy *ck additive also accepted); v3.0.0+ adds optional sequence ids :ss; responses are $OK.../$NK.... Key commands: GS state/elapsed, GE settings+flags, GG charging current (mA)+voltage (mV), GC capacity range, SC set current, SL service level, GU energy Ws+Wh, GH/SH kWh limit, FS sleep/pause, FE enable/resume.
SAFETY: this controls mains EV charging current. Treat current-setting and enable/sleep commands as advanced.

credentials.notes: The gateway can be given a web-UI password; by default the local API is open on the LAN. Provisioning passes the Wi-Fi passphrase over the setup AP's captive portal.

factory_reset.effect: Clears Wi-Fi and gateway configuration, returning it to the setup AP. Performed by holding the gateway's button (documented in the OpenEVSE user guide); the exact hold time is not transcribed here.

procedures.basis: Documented in the OpenEVSE user guide; not replayed by this project.
procedures.name: Button-hold factory reset

steps.action: Hold the gateway button until it resets and reopens the setup AP.
steps.expect: The gateway returns to Wi-Fi setup.

methods.description: Join the gateway's setup AP, open its web UI, and enter the home Wi-Fi credentials; it reboots onto the LAN and serves the API on port 80.

steps.action: Power a new/reset gateway and join its setup AP.
Open the setup UI and submit the home Wi-Fi credentials.
steps.expect: The gateway joins the LAN and answers GET /status.

setup.notes: A factory-fresh gateway hosts its own Wi-Fi AP and serves the setup UI; joining it to the home network needs no cloud. Provisioning wire steps are not transcribed here (they are the standard ESP captive-portal flow).

rejoin.notes: Wi-Fi can be reconfigured from the gateway web UI while it is reachable.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. Facts are read from the OpenEVSE ESP32 firmware docs (HTTP/MQTT), the RAPI header rapi_proc.h, and the Stoplight API docs — all first-party open source.
